import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'research-agent'})
BT="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rw=BT.strip().split("\n"); hd=rw[0].split(); M62={}
for r in rw[1:]:
    p=r.split()
    for b,v in zip(hd,p[1:]): M62[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return M62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11.0,ge=-1.0):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mm[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    sm=np.array([[sc(a,b) for b in s2] for a in s1],float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pm=Mm[i-1];px=Ix[i-1];py=Iy[i-1]
        c=np.stack([pm+go,px+ge,py+go]); Ix[i]=c.max(0); pX[i]=c.argmax(0)
        dg=np.stack([pm[:-1],px[:-1],py[:-1]]); Mm[i,1:]=dg.max(0)+sm[i-1]; pM[i,1:]=dg.argmax(0)
        Mi=Mm[i];Xi=Ix[i];Yi=Iy[i];pYi=pY[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c0=Mi[j-1]+go;c1=Xi[j-1]+go;c2=Yi[j-1]+ge
            if c0>=c1 and c0>=c2: Yi[j]=c0;pYi[j]=0
            elif c1>=c2: Yi[j]=c1;pYi[j]=1
            else: Yi[j]=c2;pYi[j]=2
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: st=2
        elif j==0: st=1
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=int(ns)
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;st=int(ns)
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;st=int(ns)
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))
def mapp(s1,s2):
    a1,a2=nw(s1,s2); i=j=0; mp={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-': i+=1
        if c2!='-': j+=1
        if c1!='-': mp[i]=(c1,c2,(j if c2!='-' else None))
    return mp,a1,a2
def fa(a):
    t=S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n"); return "".join(t[1:])
ACC=dict(ScEaf3="Q12432",ScSin3="P22579",CaEaf3="Q59K07",CaSin3="A0A1D8PCC3",
         ScRpd3="P32561",CaRpd3="A0A1D8PSA6",CaRpd31="Q5ADP0")
SEQ={k:fa(v) for k,v in ACC.items()}
def gid(mp):
    al=[(v[0],v[1]) for v in mp.values() if v[1]!='-']
    return 100*sum(1 for x,y in al if x==y)/len(al), len(al)
mpS,_,_=mapp(SEQ['ScSin3'],SEQ['CaSin3'])
print(f"ScSin3 ({len(SEQ['ScSin3'])} aa) vs CaSin3 ({len(SEQ['CaSin3'])} aa): global identity {gid(mpS)[0]:.1f}% over {gid(mpS)[1]} aligned")

# --- Sin3 interface enrichment, re-deriving the contact set ---
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def catoms(text,chains):
    cols=[];inl=False;inc=False;out=defaultdict(list);st=False;idx=None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        s=line.strip()
        if s.startswith('loop_'):
            if st: break
            inl=True;cols=[];inc=False;continue
        if inl and s.startswith('_atom_site.'):
            cols.append(s.split('.')[1]);inc=True;idx={c:i for i,c in enumerate(cols)};continue
        if inc:
            if s.startswith('#') or s.startswith('_') or s.startswith('loop_'):
                if st: break
                inc=False;inl=False;continue
            p=s.split()
            if len(p)!=len(cols): continue
            st=True
            if p[idx['group_PDB']] not in ('ATOM','HETATM'): continue
            ch=p[idx['auth_asym_id']]
            if ch not in chains or p[idx['type_symbol']]=='H': continue
            cm=p[idx['label_comp_id']]
            if cm not in AA3: continue
            out[ch].append((int(p[idx['auth_seq_id']]),cm,float(p[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(p[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(p[idx['Cartn_z']])))
    return out
def pcon(A,Bb,cut=4.5):
    Ac=np.array([a[2:] for a in A]);Bc=np.array([b[2:] for b in Bb])
    ra=np.array([a[0] for a in A]);rb=np.array([b[0] for b in Bb]);best={}
    for i in range(0,len(Ac),2500):
        d=np.sqrt(((Ac[i:i+2500,None,:]-Bc[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1))
        ii,jj=np.where(d<cut)
        for x,y in zip(ii,jj):
            k=(int(ra[i+x]),int(rb[y]));v=float(d[x,y])
            if k not in best or v<best[k]: best[k]=v
    return best
spec={'8TOF':{'sin3':['A'],'rco1':['F','G']},'8KD2':{'sin3':['B'],'rco1':['E','G']}}
sin3_if=set(); sin3_res=set()
for pid,sp in spec.items():
    txt=S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=240).text
    ch=catoms(txt,set(sp['sin3']+sp['rco1']))
    for c in sp['sin3']: sin3_res|={a[0] for a in ch[c]}
    for s_ in sp['sin3']:
        for r_ in sp['rco1']:
            for (x,y) in pcon(ch[s_],ch[r_]): sin3_if.add(x)
R=[p for p in sorted(sin3_res) if p in mpS]
I=[p for p in R if p in sin3_if]; N=[p for p in R if p not in sin3_if]
def q(ps):
    a=[(mpS[p][0],mpS[p][1]) for p in ps if mpS[p][1]!='-']; return sum(1 for x,y in a if x==y),len(a)
i1,n1=q(I); i0,n0=q(N); orr,pv=fisher_exact([[i1,n1-i1],[i0,n0-i0]])
print(f"Sin3 residues contacting Rco1: {i1}/{n1} identical = {100*i1/n1:.1f}%; resolved non-contact Sin3: {i0}/{n0} = {100*i0/n0:.1f}%; OR={orr:.2f}, p={pv:.3g}")

# --- CaEaf3 C-terminal region: is the ScEaf3 370-401 contact segment genuinely absent? ---
mpE,aE1,aE2=mapp(SEQ['ScEaf3'],SEQ['CaEaf3'])
print("\nC-terminal alignment block (ScEaf3 355-401 vs CaEaf3):")
blk=[(p,)+mpE[p] for p in range(355,402)]
print("Sc : "+ "".join(b[1] for b in blk))
print("Ca : "+ "".join(b[2] for b in blk))
print("Ca numbering at Sc355/Sc401:", mpE[355][2], mpE[401][2], "| CaEaf3 length", len(SEQ['CaEaf3']))
print("ScEaf3 C-term tail (370-401):", SEQ['ScEaf3'][369:401])
print("CaEaf3 C-term tail (last 32):", SEQ['CaEaf3'][-32:])

# --- which Ca paralog is closer to ScRpd3? ---
for k in ['CaRpd3','CaRpd31']:
    mp,_,_=mapp(SEQ['ScRpd3'],SEQ[k]); g=gid(mp)
    print(f"ScRpd3 ({len(SEQ['ScRpd3'])} aa) vs {k} ({len(SEQ[k])} aa): {g[0]:.1f}% identity over {g[1]} aligned")

# figure: interface conservation summary across three interfaces
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4.2))
labels=['Eaf3 side\n(contacts Rco1)','Rco1 side\n(contacts Eaf3)','Sin3 side\n(contacts Rco1)']
iface=[55.9,44.0,70.5]; bg=[34.3,35.1,100*i0/n0]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.36
ax.bar(x,iface,w,color='#2b6a4d',label='interface residues')
ax.bar(x+w,bg,w,color='#b0b0b0',label='resolved non-interface residues')
for xi,v in zip(x,iface): ax.text(xi,v+1,f"{v:.0f}%",ha='center',fontsize=9)
for xi,v in zip(x+w,bg): ax.text(xi,v+1,f"{v:.0f}%",ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x+w/2); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('% identical, S. cerevisiae vs C. albicans'); ax.set_ylim(0,85)
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('Rpd3S subunit interfaces are retained in C. albicans',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
